directory.description: NanoForge workspace destination directory (defaults to the workspace name when omitted)

strict.description: With strict mode (TypeScript or JavaScript but only on compatible editor)

allowBuilds.description: Package names allowed to run install/build scripts, in addition to `bun` which is always allowed (@nanoforge-dev/cli depends on it and it has its own install script). Written to pnpm-workspace.yaml (pnpm), package.json's allowScripts (npm) or trustedDependencies (bun). Ignored for yarn.

docker.description: Generate a Dockerfile building every app in the workspace into one image
